changelog:
Initial release of the thought-flow skill.

- Introduces an 8-stage collaboration loop: INTENT, CONSTRAINTS, PROPOSE, PRESS, PRACTICE, INVESTIGATE, CODIFY, BOUNDARY-CHECK.
- Provides detailed descriptions and guidance for each stage.
- Emphasizes iterative, collaborative refinement between user and agent.
- Outlines best practices for proposal, verification, and knowledge codification.
- Adds verification checklist to ensure effective use of the loop.
summary: The 8-stage collaboration loop for working with the user: INTENT, CONSTRAINTS, PROPOSE, PRESS, PRACTICE, INVESTIGATE, CODIFY, BOUNDARY-CHECK. Use when starting a new task (state intent and constraints up front), when proposing a plan (include options + a recommendation), when the user pushes back on a proposal, when something fails or looks broken and needs investigation, or when deciding whether to codify knowledge into an AGENTS.md rule or a SKILL.md procedure.
